title: The Effect of Computer Monitoring on Employees’ Productivity in Telecommuting Arrangements
eligible_reason: Single-date DiD. The USPTO began monitoring telecommuting examiners' computer activity in February 2015; teleatshock = 1 for examiners telecommuting at the shock and post_monitor = 1 for the six months after February 2015 (tpm = interaction). All treated examiners switch on in the same month. Examiners' staggered telecommuting start dates (tele_month) only define the treated group, not a treatment. The FE columns also absorb GS-grade-group and tenure FE.
